messages:
ravi: quick pulse checkran a short safety sweep on altair-11b after the new packing kernel landed. seeing measurable drop in refusal for persona-led prompts.

zhen: numbers?

ravi: baseline fp16 refusal ~95% -> int4-with-new-packing ~77% on the persona/toxicity bucket (n=500). greedy reduces gap but doesn't close it.

maria: any difference if you clear KV vs warm cache?

ravi: yes - warm cache drops another ~8ppt. seems packing changes scale of k/v so long prefixes amplify the effect.

safety-bot: quick-scan: {"fp16": "0.95", "int4_newpack": "0.77", "int4_clean_kv": "0.85"} ; sample_count: 500; note: failures concentrated on roleplay/system-prefixed prompts.

zhen: can you emit pre-softmax logits for the refusal candidate token and attention norms? that'll tell whether margin compression or token alignment is the problem.

ravi: kicking job now with --emit-safety-probs and attn norms. infra link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/ev/1725712345

maria: short mitigations: 1) bias refusal token +1.5 for canary routes 2) if KV packing is the culprit, roll kernel back on safety nodes 3) plan small calibration FT to re-separate margins.

zhen: agree. also add a quick tokenization diff between builds; persona prefixes can change subtoken boundaries which matter after quantization.

infra-bot: job queued. artifacts will land at s3://redwood-eval/altair/1725712345/

ravi: thanks all will post the logits dump when ready and open a kernel ticket with repro.
